claude_proposed_widenings.name: EffectAtom.create_object
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The item's primary mechanic is creating a persistent tower object with a fixed footprint, dimensions, and durability profile. The current surface has object attachments and alter_item_kind, but no honest effect variant for creating a durable structure in play.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: cause it to grow rapidly into a square adamantine tower

claude_proposed_widenings.name: created-object persistence / reversion state
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The deployed tower must keep damage across form changes, can revert only when empty, and supports later item-controlled interactions like commanded door opening. The current surface cannot reference a previously created object instance and carry its state across later activations.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Repeating the command word causes the tower to revert to statuette form, which works only if the tower is empty... Shrinking the tower back down to statuette form doesn't repair damage to the tower.

discrepancies: no content/magic_item_instant_fortress.json authored; accepted self-report-only widening path
